# From Educational Harvesting to Productive Capacity

> A health economics framework for AI-assisted clinical reasoning education, competency-based medical education and open knowledge infrastructure, by Abhishek Choudhary (AyeAI, ORCID 0009-0002-0684-8320). Paper, a scenario simulator and six Colab notebooks for medicos.

## Read these first
- [The paper, Markdown](paper/manuscript_source.md): the canonical text, also as PDF, Word and LaTeX in paper/.
- [References with evidence states](data/references.json): verified entries name their sources and what was checked; open entries say how they will be checked.
- [The browser model](hecon-model.js): identical to hecon/model.py and hecon/game.py; tests/parity.js proves it.
- [Repository](https://github.com/zistgah/hecon): README, CONTRACT.md, CONTEXT.md, AGENTS.md, COMPONENTS.md.

## Rules you will be judged against
- Every number in the simulator is an assumption; nothing is an estimate or a finding.
- Retrieve before you assert; a claim without verification carries its evidence state.
- The master contract: https://github.com/zistgah/governance/blob/main/CONTRACT.md
